research.hook: Nobody tells you the three exact things you should (and shouldn’t) say to a lonely friend.
research.tip: Say "I’ve noticed you’ve been quieter lately. I’m here if you want to talk or just hang out – no pressure."

data.title: Loneliness ka Brain Effect aur Kya Kehna Hai
data.title_en: Loneliness, Brain Effects & What to Say

scenes.text: Kya tum jaante ho akelaapan dimaag ko badal sakta?
scenes.text_en: Do you know loneliness can change the brain?

scenes.text: Jab tumhara classmate exam stress se chup rehta, tum sochte ho sab theek.
scenes.text_en: When your classmate stays silent due to exam stress, you think everything's fine.

scenes.text: Aur teesra point sabse zaroori hai, suno dhyan se.
scenes.text_en: And the third point is most important, listen carefully.

scenes.text: Research suggests loneliness may raise cortisol, affecting decisions.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests loneliness may raise cortisol, affecting decisions.

scenes.text: Studies suggest loneliness may affect the hippocampus and could increase heart risk.
scenes.text_en: Studies suggest loneliness may affect the hippocampus and could increase heart risk.

scenes.text: Pehle, unki feelings ko simple shabd me accept karo.
scenes.text_en: First, accept their feelings in simple words.

scenes.text: Phir, batao ki tum hamesha unke liye available ho.
scenes.text_en: Then, tell them you’re always available for them.

scenes.text: Last mein, ek casual invite do, bina kisi pressure ke.
scenes.text_en: Finally, give a casual invite with no pressure.

scenes.text: Ye line us dost ko bhejo jo aksar akela feel karta hai.
scenes.text_en: Send this line to the friend who often feels alone.

scenes.text: Yaad rakho, ek simple ‘main yahan hoon’ se farak padta hai.
scenes.text_en: Remember, a simple ‘I’m here’ makes a difference.

scenes.text: Message them today to let them know you care.
scenes.text_en: Message them today to let them know you care.

scenes.text: Agar tum bhi yeh karte ho, tum akele nahi ho – share karo!
scenes.text_en: If you do this too, you’re not alone – share!
